  • Constructor Details

    • InstalledPluginInfo

      public InstalledPluginInfo(String name, String marketplace, String directSourceId, String version, Boolean enabled, String installedFrom, String source, Boolean managed, Boolean managedDesiredEnabled, Boolean installed, String description, InstalledPluginVerifiedSource verifiedSource, String iconUrl)
      Creates a record without plugin ownership or content-root metadata.
      Parameters:
      name - Plugin name
      marketplace - Marketplace the plugin came from. Empty string ("") for direct repo / URL / local installs.
      directSourceId - Opaque, stable hash identifying a direct (non-marketplace) install source. Present only for direct repo / URL / local installs; absent for marketplace plugins. Same source yields the same id; distinct sources never collide.
      version - Installed version (when reported by the plugin manifest)
      enabled - Whether the plugin is currently enabled for new sessions
      installedFrom - Absolute path of the marketplace directory a live plugin was resolved from. Present only on live, never-persisted records — a plugin belonging to a directory/local marketplace, which is loaded from its real directory on every pass instead of a copy under the installed-plugins cache. Its presence is what marks a listed plugin as live: such a plugin is always present on disk, so `enabled` is its only meaningful state and it is never "not installed".
      source - Runtime-reported plugin provenance. Currently set to "builtin" only for plugins registered through the trusted host built-in boundary; absent for installed, marketplace, direct, and live plugins.
      managed - Whether enterprise managed settings control this plugin's enabled state.
      managedDesiredEnabled - The enabled state required by enterprise managed settings, when this plugin spec is managed.
      installed - Whether the managed desired plugin currently has an installed or live record. Set to false for a managed desired entry retained in the listing after installation or reconciliation failed.
      description - Description from the manifest of the installed copy. Present only for a direct install pinned to one GitHub commit, such as a verified install from GitHub.
      verifiedSource - The GitHub repository and commit a direct install is pinned to, from its install record. Present only for a direct install pinned to one GitHub commit, such as a verified install from GitHub; absent for marketplace, local and unpinned installs.
      iconUrl - HTTPS URL of the plugin's icon on raw.githubusercontent.com, retained from the catalogue entry it was installed from. Untrusted external content: load it without credentials. Present only for a direct install pinned to one GitHub commit whose catalogue entry had an icon.
